title: Cheese
body:
Description

Cheese can be bought at The Oak Depot for $444.

There are 1194 possible different colors[1] of cheese. Each piece of cheese has a 1/2000 chance to be neon[2].

The color of cheese can be checked using Filter Conveyor, it will appear as "(Item Cheese) color: #Hex".

Trivia + Gallery

-There are 2388 unique cheeses you can obtain, half of which are neon.

-It would take you 888000K to get one neon.

-In older versions of Oaklands, cheese with a hexcode that has 2 of the colors set to FF could not be obtained Eg.(FF38FF)

In pre-release this item used to have a cubic hitbox. Neon Pink Cheese

Neon Pink Cheese

  1. ↑ Cheese uses a RGB hex system with values from 38(56) to ff(255). Only one of the colour values can have the range, while the other 2 are ff and 38. This makes a total of 1194 different colours a cheese can choose from. (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OUXumuS65elUodTi6t02eqyDhtd6lLNbP8Ew7Y0TrbE/edit?usp=sharing)
  2. ↑ This is a separate roll from the colour.
